# cpmdc

> C ABI for embedding OpenCPMD in OmniPotentRPC tools. Hosts pass Cap'n Proto CPMDParams once, ForceInput per geometry step, and receive native C results or PotentialResult messages for rgpot and other drivers.

Machine-readable inventory: schema/inventory/cpmd_features.json.
Human docs source: docs/orgmode/ (export to Sphinx with pixi run -e docs docbld).

The C ABI exposes 47 functions; the feature table lists 47 ABI rows, 521 parameter fields, 25 deck sections, and 624 catalog keywords.
Authoritative API tables: reference/c-abi, reference/contracts, reference/python, reference/cpmd-options.

AGENTS.md at the repository root describes layout, build, test, and docs for agents.
Full plain text of every page: https://cpmdc.rgoswami.me/llms-full.txt (committed as llms-full.txt).
